control.$description: Every one-line control: a button, a text field, a select's trigger, a segmented control, a link tab. Five sizes, xs to xl; md is the default.

height.$description: 28, 32, 40, 44 and 48 px; md is the system's control height.

gap.$description: Between an icon and the label or value: 6, 6, 8, 8 and 10 px.

icon-size.$description: 16 px up to md, then 20 px.

border-width.$description: The edge, the same at every size: thin, and twice that with an error.
